description: Recent token transactions of any 0x address across every ERC-20 it holds: the newest 50 transfers in or out over recent blocks, each with token symbol, amount, counterparty, direction, block and transaction hash. Live Transfer logs on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon; native-coin transfers are not included. Use to see what a wallet did lately, confirm a payment in any token, or audit activity before a deal. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan (100-10000, default 2000; Base and Optimism make a block every 2 s, so 2,000 is about 67 minutes; Ethereum every 12 s)

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb, op or polygon

name: wallet_transactions
title: Wallet transactions, history
